summary: The customer, representing Satpura Logistics Private Limited, acknowledged having two overdue invoices, with the first invoice SL/26-27/0002 amounting to ₹2,04,000 due on 2026-08-26. The customer agreed to pay this amount by September 30, 2026, via UPI, although they requested a 10% adjustment on the second invoice, SL/26-27/0003, which was not accepted at the moment. Next, the customer's payment promise for the first invoice has been recorded, and further communication regarding the second invoice will follow.
